verdict.rationale: Blink Files is described as enabling work on 'local projects' as well as remote machines, and selection/drag can move content to and from other apps, hinting at iOS Files-provider-style access to other apps' sandboxes, but no evidence explicitly confirms cross-app file/repo access or Files.app integration mechanics. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Files.app/UIDocumentPicker integration, confirmation that repos in other apps' sandboxes can be opened/edited, and independent verification of this workflow.
